summary: Happy brushes one or both flat hands upward on the chest in a circular motion, with a smile. The smile is not optional.
steps: Place flat hands on your chest, palms facing in.
Brush them upward and outward in small circles, two or three times.
Smile. HAPPY with a flat face looks sarcastic or sad.
note: To say 'very happy,' make the circles bigger and faster and the smile wider. ASL rarely adds a VERY sign; it changes the sign itself.
mistakes: Brushing downward. Downward from the chest is SAD territory.
A blank face. The expression is half the sign.

faq.q: Can I sign HAPPY with one hand?
faq.a: Yes. One-handed HAPPY is common in casual signing. Two hands is a little more emphatic.
